Staff-Ready Owner preview

A new hire’s paperwork, already filled in.

This short preview is set up with a finished example, so you don’t have to type anything. A sample worker, Amina Yusuf, has completed the only two forms in this preview — the federal Form W-4 and Form I-9. The government’s own fillable PDFs are built into the app: she answered simple questions, and the app wrote her answers into the original forms themselves. What downloads is the real IRS and USCIS paperwork, filled in — never a recreation. Look at what she saw, then open the manager view and download her forms the way you would in the real system.

1

The worker answers simple questions

On her phone, in one sitting — about ten minutes. No typing into a dense PDF: her answers carry from field to field, and she checks the filled original form before she signs.

2

You watch it land

Her packet shows up in your manager view, marked complete the moment she signs.

3

You download the real forms

The W-4 and I-9 are the government’s own PDF files with her answers written into them — the original layout, because nothing is redrawn.

This is what Amina saw on her phone. She answered simple questions; before signing, she could open each form and check the real government form with her answers already in it. In this preview her answers are already in — tap Review on a form to see the filled original she checked.

What happens with a real worker

You send one invite link. The worker answers simple questions on her phone — she never has to type into the PDF itself — and before she signs, she can open the filled original form and check every answer in place. Anyone who stops halfway shows here as Pending and can pick up where she left off. When she signs, her file lands here exactly like Amina’s, and each form downloads as the official government document itself, filled in — not a recreation, not a summary sheet.

Staff-Ready owner preview — two forms only (W-4 and I-9). The downloads are the official IRS and USCIS PDF files with the sample answers written into their own fields. The full system carries the rest of the onboarding packet.

Every name, address, and number on this page is a made-up sample, so you can click and download freely.
